data.name: GravityMan
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

—The Ceiling Becomes the Floor, and the World is Upside Down—

2D side-scrolling action game with simple controls and gravity mechanics

With the press of a button, the floor beneath your feet instantly becomes a ceiling, and the ceiling above your head instantly becomes a floor.

Make skillful use of the terrain and gimmicks to conquer a variety of stages.

Game Features 

Various Traps: Moving and rotating platforms. A series of difficult sections.

Simple Controls: Three actions: Movement, Jump, and Gravity Reversal.

Abundant BGM: Change to a different soundtrack if you get stuck.

From above to below

Flip while jumping, etc.

Infinite routes to clear

If "clearing" were easy, it wouldn't be an action game! 

Of course, there's a penalty for falling.

Checkpoints will also be reset.

Now, manipulate gravity and run freely through upside-down stages!

Game Production: First Work

"Gravity Man"

- The gravity button can be pressed again after landing.

- No input is accepted at the point of impact.

Question 

Q: There's noise on the screen!

A: Please change the vertical sync settings.

Q: I'm buried under a block.

A: This is by design.

Q: The checkpoint has been returned to.

A: This is by design.

[Live Commentary/Streaming Terms] 

As long as you abide by the following terms, both individuals and corporations are permitted to stream gameplay videos.

- Monetization through video site features (ad revenue, tips, etc.) is permitted.

- Game commentary/streaming content that contains defamatory content or violates public order and morals is prohibited.

- Any unauthorized acquisition, modification, or tampering with the game's program or data is prohibited.

- MEYOSOFT assumes no responsibility for any damage or problems arising from game commentary/streaming.

- The guidelines are subject to change and update at any time. Please check the latest guidelines before posting.

We may take measures such as deleting or suspending broadcasts that do not comply with the guidelines or are otherwise deemed inappropriate. If requested, please delete or suspend the broadcast without delay.
